description:
The project site is located at Dam Neck, Building 372. The Contractor shall utilize directional boring to restore power to (QTY 16) street lights; provide and install appropriate gauge wire from all inoperable streetlights (QTY 16) to electrical panel utilizing directional boring (Approximately 2000 LF); demolish all light poles that have deteriorated and otherwise unusable (QTY 16); provide and install new light poles; make all necessary wire connections for proper operation of connected components; re-energize all electrical power and test lights for proper operation.

ONLY CONTRACTORS IN MACC GROUP ID: ML-C00075 CAN BID ON THIS PROJECT.
